data.title: 户隐憧子 · 凉棚阴凉处的会长督导
data.action: 端正优雅地坐在木椅上，单手拿着卷起的夏日活动行程表轻抵下巴，另一只手轻拂被海风吹散的黑发，眼神温柔沉静，嘴角噙着让人安心的端庄微笑
data.location: 海滨俱乐部遮阳木棚下的观景区
data.lighting: 木棚漏下的规整光影，反衬出少女白皙无瑕的肌肤
data.mood: 端庄沉稳、温柔可靠、学姐风范
data.description: 海滨休假营地安静的遮阳木棚下。户隐憧子身着学院名媛海军蓝白撞色挂脖泳裙，举止从容端庄。她轻轻拂开被风撩乱的刘海，微笑着示意你在身旁坐下，学姐特有的成熟从容与无微不至的细心，让炎热的夏日海滩也多了一份安心静谧。
data.promptProse: Under the cool timber shade of a resort pavilion overlooking the bright morning beach, Touko sits with poised composure holding a rolled summer itinerary near her chin and smiling warmly as dappled sunlight crosses the bench.
data.animaCaption: Seated gracefully on a wooden bench beneath a shaded seaside pergola overlooking the sunlit beach, she brushes windblown hair back while touching a rolled schedule to her chin with a serene smile in a navy-and-white nautical halterneck swimdress.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a refined nautical navy-blue swimdress piped with crisp white trim, a tailored sweetheart halter bodice, and a modest flared skirt over bare legs.
